meta.title: Monster Cannon — Aim. Bounce. Destroy everything.
meta.description: Bounce-physics arcade shooter: aim the cannon, ricochet your ball off the walls and smash straight through the monster horde. Endless waves, 5 bosses, 21 cannons. Plays offline, free, no in-app purchases.
meta.ogDescription: Smart angles beat brute force. Endless waves, 5 bosses, satisfying bounce physics. Free and fully playable offline.

hero.subtitle: Load the cannon, take aim, and <hl>let the bounce do the rest</hl>. Smart angles beat brute force.

trailer.label: Monster Cannon trailer
trailer.caption: 34 seconds of the real game, no flattering cuts.

solution.heading: Smart angles beat brute force. 💥
solution.valueProp: Touch and drag to aim: a trajectory line shows exactly where the ball will bounce. Release, watch the ricochet, and chain a combo of kills with one perfect shot. One finger, no tutorial, runs last minutes, not hours.

benefits.title: Aim, release, watch the ricochet
benefits.body: The trajectory line shows where the ball will bounce before you even fire. Bank off the walls, hit what hides behind an obstacle: skill is seeing the angle others can't.

benefits.title: Endless monster waves
benefits.body: There is no final level. Only how far you can go. Monsters advance on their own and the difficulty never stops climbing.

benefits.title: One boost between every wave
benefits.body: Sturdy Ball (pierces +1 enemy), Ball Reserve (+1 ball), Heavy Ball (+1 damage), Fast Cannon (−0.5 s reload). Stack the effects into a build that never repeats.

benefits.title: What you earn stays yours
benefits.body: Four permanent upgrades paid in gold: three go up to level 8, the cannon's HP up to level 3. The cannons you unlock stay with you forever.

screenshots.heading: The game, <hl>for real.</hl>
screenshots.subheading: Captured in the current build, untouched.

items.caption: The wave saturates, the screen explodes. It never stops.
Blob King, Speedy, Guardian, Splitter, Overlord — at waves 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50.
At the end of each wave, you pick your boost. Every run builds differently.
One ball, several bounces, a fat combo and a shower of gold.
Four free, the rest from 12,000 to 400,000 gold. Purely cosmetic.
Three quests drawn every day, eight tiered achievement chains, all paid in gold.
Your best wave, against the whole world.

items.headline: Beat a boss, its mechanic stays.
items.body: Blob King, Speedy, Guardian, Splitter and Overlord wait for you at waves 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50. Each brings a new mechanic — obstacles, shields, splitting monsters — and once beaten, it joins the regular waves for good.

items.headline: The more you think, the more damage you deal.
items.body: Before every shot, the line shows exactly where the ball will bounce. One perfect shot can clear half the screen and chain a combo.

items.headline: Your progress stays, even when you die.
items.body: Four permanent upgrades bought with gold. The cost grows quadratically: reaching level 8 takes several runs, and you feel it on the very next shot.

items.headline: Unlock, equip, show off.
items.body: Four free cannons to start with, seventeen more between 12,000 and 400,000 gold. None of them change your stats: it's cosmetic, not pay-to-win.

items.headline: Always a good reason to fire it up tomorrow.
items.body: Three quests drawn every day and eight tiered achievement chains, all paid in gold — the gold that funds the lab and the cannons.

items.headline: Your best wave, against the world.
items.body: An online leaderboard on the wave you reached. The game is in English and French, switchable any time in the settings.

items.a: A roguelike arcade game: you control a cannon and fire balls that ricochet off the walls and pierce through monsters. Combat is real time, waves are endless, and you pick a boost at the end of every wave.
Touch and drag to aim: a trajectory line shows where the ball will bounce. Release to fire. One finger, no tutorial to sit through, and a run lasts minutes, not hours.

Yes. No in-app purchases, no interstitial ads. The only ads are two buttons you trigger yourself: revive after death (5 times a day max) and double a run's gold (2 times a day max). The whole economy runs on gold you earn by playing.
No. All 21 cannons are purely cosmetic, none of them change your stats. What makes you stronger are the boosts you pick during a run and the four permanent lab upgrades.
Five: Blob King (wave 10), Speedy (20), Guardian (30), Splitter (40) and Overlord (50).

items.q: Do I need an internet connection to play?
items.a: No, the game plays fully offline, no wifi needed. A connection is only used for the optional rewarded ads and the global leaderboard.

items.q: Is the game available in my language?
items.a: It ships in English and French, switchable any time in the settings.

items.q: Does the game collect my data?
items.a: Only anonymous usage statistics (wave reached, boosts picked, language, device model) to balance the game. No account, no email address, no contact details. The full breakdown is on the game's privacy page.

finalCta.heading: Your cannon is waiting. <hl>Go set your record.</hl>
finalCta.supporting: Aim well. Bounce smart. Smash them all. Free, plays offline, no in-app purchases.
